study type: Prospective interventional pilot study, randomised controlled trial
exposure: ERAS protocol (comprehensive preoperative education, multimodal non-opioid analgesia, early oral intake, early ambulation)
cohort: The study included 208 women with a mean age of 27.08+/-4.54 years undergoing elective Caesarean Section.
finding: Implementation of ERAS protocols for elective CS significantly reduced postoperative pain scores, eliminated opioid dependency, prevented postoperative ileus, and shortened hospital stays compared to traditional care.
followup_time: Up to 10 days post-surgery (until hospital discharge)
